state_machine: RESERVED: immutable whole ledger precedes non-allocation create; allocation bootstrap uses complete reviewed in-memory template; full charge remains forever
READY: root has complete bounded role payload, exact schema/path/source/ledger authority and attributed peer message where required
CREATE_ATTEMPTED: exclusive original handle then immediate original disk-type/link/final-path/identity checks BEFORE payload write; no alternate path/retry on failure
PUBLISHED: full original readback/hash/identity and retained ancestry verified, owned handle closed; bytes immutable
FAILED_CONSUMED: close owned handles, preserve partial or empty artifact and all reservations; no overwrite, repair, delete, release or reassignment
raw_evidence: Original tool chunk output strings exact; native JSON parsed only with exact integers; capture is metadata not native custody

review_roles.root_disposition: Root stores full bounded actual-review peer confirmation of exact published bytes before adopting result; distinct from peer judgment
review_roles.closeout: final pins/census/link/refusal facts; no source/runtime launch authority
review_roles.actual_review: one final independent actual review; may accept refusal with facts separately
review_roles.source_review: one final source/transport review; prelaunch, or bounded refusal if missing; not live source mutation authority
review_roles.contract_adoption: Root stores full bounded source-review peer confirmation of exact published bytes before runtime admission; independent approval cannot be self-certified

fallback_policy: No sidecars, temp files, generic shell redirection, apply_patch, append, retry-to-another-name or postlaunch unreviewed transport
capture_bounds: Complete encoded capture bytes plus envelope/chunks/stderr/failure paths must fit1048576; external complete derivative65536. No truncation, optimistic stream-size assumption or extra file. Static unknown refuses admission.

delegation.actual_reviewer: different from source reviewer/authors; read-only bounded message; confirm published text/hash
delegation.root: sole publisher via exact source-reviewed typed writer
delegation.source_reviewer: read-only; bounded message only; confirm published text/hash

extra_file_result: INCOMPLETE_REFUSED even when whole byte/file envelope has spare capacity
writer_guards: before create: all exact paths unused and checked individually; closed schema/full encoded byte size/exact charge
before create: canonical path and retained ordinary ancestry
allocation-only bootstrap: pin reviewed writer/design/source and closed full in-memory ledger template before first create; no self-hash
before non-allocation create: require successfully verified/closed immutable allocation pin
CreateNew/exclusive original handle; no overwrite or fallback
immediately after create for ALL roles, before payload write: original-handle ordinary disk file, one link, canonical final path and native identity
bounded write/flush; original full readback identity length SHA256; retained ancestry recheck and close
postcreate validation failure closes owned handle, preserves artifact and full reservation
all failed and unused reservations retained; count off-directory operation artifacts too

allocation_bootstrap.successful_result: original-handle identity length full-byte readback hash and successful closure yield immutable allocation pin
allocation_bootstrap.authority: exact independently reviewed writer/design/source pins and closed in-memory16-role template; not a nonexistent ledger hash
allocation_bootstrap.failure: metadata UUID and16 charges consumed; preserve partial ledger; prohibit other creates and runtime; bounded failure only in original chat/tool trace, no sidecar
before_create: charge all16 full reservations in memory
after_create_before_write: ordinary disk file from original handle
exact canonical final path from original handle

confirmation_destinations.unavailable_or_consumed_destination: no other file or slot reassignment; refusal remains in original chat/tool trace
confirmation_destinations.post_closeout_comment: read-only message; no mutation of immutable records or extra file
